steps.title: A method
steps.say: A method names a job. This one takes two numbers and returns their average.

steps.title: Why bother
steps.say: `DriveMath` never touches a motor or sensor, so each method can be tested on its own. The drivetrain calls them, and `Robot.java` reads almost like a sentence.

steps.title: Open DriveMath.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DriveMath` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Your first method
steps.say: Start with `rotationsToMeters`, then click **Verify**: each method has its own checkpoint.

steps.title: Find linearSpeed
steps.say: The next method down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `linearSpeed` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Then this one
steps.say: The average of the two sides.
